question: Who among the following was honoured with the Padma Vibhushan award 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M Venkaiah Naidu**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **M Venkaiah Naidu**, the former Vice President of India, was honoured with the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan award in 2024** for his exceptional contributions to public service and Indian politics. 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the second-highest civilian award in India, recognizing "exceptional and distinguished service" in various fields, including public affairs, arts, science, and social work. 
• **M Venkaiah Naidu** has been an influential leader in Indian politics, serving as the Vice President from **2017 to 2022** and holding key portfolios such as Minister of Urban Development, Housing, and Parliamentary Affairs. 
• He is known for his strong advocacy of rural development, urban planning, and promotion of Indian culture and values. 
• The **Padma Awards** are announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day**, and recipients are selected based on their notable contributions to society. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Padma Vibhushan Award:** 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is part of the **Padma Awards**, which also include the **Padma Bhushan** and **Padma Shri**, conferred by the Government of India. 
• It is awarded for "exceptional and distinguished service" across various fields such as arts, public affairs, science, sports, and more. 
• The award was established in **1954** and is conferred by the President of India. 
• **M Venkaiah Naidu:** 
• **Born:** 1 July 1949, in Andhra Pradesh, India. 
• Known for his eloquence and passion for Indian culture, Naidu has been a dedicated member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**. 
• He played a pivotal role in urban development initiatives like the **Smart Cities Mission** and **Housing for All**. 
• **Other Awardees in 2024:** 
• The **Padma Awards** 2024 also recognized several other prominent personalities for their contributions in diverse fields such as arts, science, medicine, and social work. 
• These awards showcase India's recognition of excellence and service to the nation. 
• **Selection Process:** 
• The recipients are selected by a committee constituted by the **Prime Minister of India**. 
• Nominations are received from the general public, government bodies, and non-governmental organizations. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Padma Awards 2024:** 
• The awards were announced on **25 January 2024**, recognizing a total of **106 awardees**, including **6 Padma Vibhushan**, **9 Padma Bhushan**, and **91 Padma Shri** recipients. 
• The awards are a reflection of India's gratitude towards individuals who have made a lasting impact in their respective domains. 
• **Significance:** 
• The awards promote the spirit of national service and encourage others to contribute meaningfully to society. </ul
